create_OptimWrapper_with_clip_grad: create an OptimWrapper instance with gradient clipping by norm to cap gradient values during training
update_params_with_accumulation: update model parameters using OptimWrapper with gradient accumulation over multiple iterations before stepping
use_optim_context_for_ddp: use the optim_context manager to avoid unnecessary gradient synchronization in DistributedDataParallel during gradient accumulation
initialize_count_status_for_resume: initialize gradient accumulation count status to handle resuming training with correct inner and max counts
scale_loss_for_accumulation: scale the loss tensor by the accumulation factor to ensure correct gradient magnitudes during accumulated updates
